newsitem.title: USA: U.S. reserve assets fell $6.89 bln in January.
newsitem.headline: U.S. reserve assets fell $6.89 bln in January.

text.p: The Treasury Department said on Friday that U.S. reserve assets fell $6.89 billion in January to $68.2 billion, from $75.09 billion in December.
U.S. holdings of foreign currencies dropped to $32.99 billion from $38.29 billion in December.
Gold stock totaled $11.05 billion in each month.
Special Drawing Rights with the International Monetary Fund declined to $9.79 billion in January from $10.31 billion.
The value of the U.S. reserve position wiith the IMF fell to $14.37 billion in January from $15.44 billion in December.
